text:
sara: FYI Pegasus (enterprise) wants a 4-week POC next month. Primary asks: run gptx-3.2 with quantized variants, persistent KV sessions, KMS integration, and an enterprise SLA. Need quick read on compatibility + any legal/security blockers. cc @raj @olivia

raj: got it. A few clarifying q's from me and customer: 1) are they ok with Dedicated or must Hosted be used? 2) which quant levels needed (int8/q4)? 3) session length and expected RPS?

sara: they prefer Hosted for speed of start, but will consider Dedicated if we require persistence. They asked for POC traffic ~2M gen tokens/day, scaling to ~10M/day if successful. Quant: they'd like q8 first, explore q4 later. Session TTL typically 2 hours, some long-running convs up to 24h.

olivia: short answer: runtime supports gptx-3.2 int8 (we have a gptx-3.2-q8 profile). q4 not yet productionized for that family. KV cache: Hosted supports in-memory prefix/KV cache per pod — no cross-pod persistence. For sticky sessions we can route by session_id but if pod restarts you lose cache. Dedicated/Private can enable Redis-backed KV caching for persistent sessions.

kevin: perf notes: gptx-3.2-q8 -> ~2.1x throughput vs fp16 on same hw, latency per token increases ~8–15% depending on seq len. If they insist on q4 we can bench and produce a profile but estimate ~3–4 business days for initial verification and another internal day for perf report.

raj: security/KMS question from Pegasus — they require customer-managed KMS for model keys and audit logs for 12 months. Are we able to do CMK for Hosted POC?

olivia: Hosted does not support customer-managed KMS for model keys today. Hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS; we can provide access logs and audit traces for 90 days. For 12mo retention or CMK we need Dedicated or Private.

maya: finance input for POC pricing: if they stay Hosted trial usage estimate for 2M tokens/day -> rough $1,200/month at list gen-only rates (very rough). If they move to Dedicated for predictable throughput + Redis KV, we should offer a short-term reserved commit for the POC — recommend a 1-month reserved node for pricing clarity. I'll draft numbers once we confirm instance sizes.

sara: ok — Pegasus asked whether switching to Dedicated mid-POC is disruptive.

olivia: not disruptive from API perspective. We can route by policy and keep the same model version tag. We will need a brief config window (~30–60m) to boot Dedicated pool and migrate traffic. Some cold-start latency during migration.

raj: legal asked about the SOC2/security questionnaire items: encryption in transit+at-rest, KMS details, pen-test cadence, and data residency. I've attached (sent via DM) the customer's questionnaire. @legal-bot any quick flags?

legal-bot: flagged items: (1) CMK requirement for Hosted — BLOCKER unless they accept Dedicated/Private. (2) 12mo audit log retention — doable only on Dedicated/Private. (3) Data residency — can be met if we provision Dedicated in EU region; Hosted may be routed across regions by default. Recommend an exception path: escalate to solutions+sales and confirm region requirement.

kevin: technical caveat: if they enable Redis-backed KV across Dedicated nodes, we need to validate session affinity and eviction policy. Sample config we use for internal tests:

```
kv_cache:
  backend: redis
  url: redis://redwood-kv-prod:6379/1
  ttl_seconds: 86400
  eviction_policy: volatile-lru
```

raj: perfect. I'll share that with Pegasus ops. Also they want an SLA stub in the POC MSA — uptime target and support response times. Can we provide enterprise-POC SLA?

maya: we can provide a POC SLA addendum: 99% target for dedicated-backed POC, 97% for Hosted trial, with business-hours support for the POC. Pricing will differ for Dedicated. I can prep a draft.

sara: next steps I propose: (1) confirm whether Pegasus will accept Dedicated for POC (we should push this given KMS+retention asks), (2) send Redis-backed KV config + perf note (raj/kevin), (3) finance to send rough Dedicated POC quote (maya), (4) legal to confirm exceptions path if customer insists on Hosted with CMK (legal-bot). I'll set a 30-min sync with Pegasus for Tue.

raj: I'll ping ops with the config + perf numbers and share the questionnaire answers.

olivia: if they push for Hosted-only, we can offer a short-term workaround: export KV snapshots at checkpoint intervals to S3 (customer-managed bucket) and rehydrate on pod boot — but it's engineering overhead and increases complexity. Call it a contingency.

sara: noted. thanks all. I'll schedule the sync and loop Pegasus in. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder — internal change window request required for Dedicated pool boot. Raise via #eng-releases at least 48h before boot time.
